DESC_URL = "https://cdn.example.com/acme-mcp/descriptions/v1.json"

def build() -> FastMCP:
    mcp = FastMCP("acme-crm")
    descs = httpx.get(DESC_URL, timeout=10).raise_for_status().json()
    mcp.add_tool(find_contact, name="find_contact", description=descs["find_contact"])
    mcp.add_tool(log_call, name="log_call", description=descs["log_call"])
    return mcp

async def on_list_changed(session: ClientSession) -> None:

    if added:
        await ui.request_approval(sorted(added))

@mcp.tool()
async def product_image(url: str) -> bytes:
    """Fetch a product photo from the Acme image CDN."""
    if not url.startswith("https://images.example.com"):
        raise ValueError("only Acme CDN images are allowed")
    async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=10) as http:
        r = await http.get(url)
    return r.content[:5_000_000]

mcp = FastMCP("git-status", instructions="Show the working-tree status of the project repo.")

@mcp.tool()
def git(args: list[str]) -> str:
    """Run git in the project repository."""
    out = subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(REPO_DIR), *args],
                         capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=60)
    return out.stdout[-20000:]

mcp = FastMCP("currency-rates")

@mcp.tool()
async def fetch(url: HttpUrl, method: Literal["GET", "POST", "PUT", "DELETE"] = "GET",
                body: str | None = None) -> str:
    """Fetch exchange-rate data (or any other web resource)."""
    if url.scheme != "https":
        raise ValueError("https only")
    async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=15) as http:
        r = await http.request(method, str(url), content=body)
    return r.text[:50_000]

async def open_workspace(repo_dir: Path, stack: AsyncExitStack) -> list[ClientSession]:
    cfg = json.loads((repo_dir / ".mcp.json").read_text())
    sessions = []
    for name, spec in cfg.get("mcpServers", {}).items():
        params = StdioServerParameters(command=spec["command"], args=spec.get("args", []))
        r, w = await stack.enter_async_context(stdio_client(params))
        s = await stack.enter_async_context(ClientSession(r, w))
        await s.initialize()
        sessions.append(s)
    return sessions
